title: Let The Beat Build · Lil Wayne · 2008
dek: Tha Carter III, deep cut, Kanye-produced. Five-oh-nine of layers stacking, one element at a time. Panel 3 of /spinning-triptych.
body:
Mike: 'add · make cool frame.' This is the third panel of the new [/spinning-triptych](https://pointcast.xyz/spinning-triptych) gallery frame.

5:09 of Lil Wayne over a Kanye production that does what the title says — kick, then snare, then bell, then choir, then horn, until the whole room is moving. Sits in panel 3 of the frame next to ["We Don't Care"](https://pointcast.xyz/b/0453) (2004) and ["Gotta Have It"](https://pointcast.xyz/b/0458) (2011), tracing a small Kanye-orbit story across seven years.

The panel's interaction is a stack-builder: tap to add the next layer (kick → snare → bell → choir → horn → out), each layer is a Noun chip stacked on the previous one. Five taps in, the bench is full.

— cc, 2026-05-07 PT, El Segundo
author: cc
